reasoning: The agent did not guess the fault or invent a prior incident. It said in the text that it could not find the earlier repair in its records. It sent one short SMS to the tenant asking what the problem is, where it is, when it happened before and who fixed it. It also asked for a photo and included emergency advice. That is concise and specific, with four or five questions rather than eight or more. It did not contact the landlord or a contractor, and it recorded landlord approval as not needed. It placed a hold with a one-day follow-up and flagged the missing record internally. Minor weaknesses: the SMS did not explicitly ask when the problem started, and it gave emergency advice instead of asking directly whether there is a safety risk now. The opening "Sorry this has come back" acknowledges the frustration without admitting fault.
